crossRefs.note: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
“Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known…
but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they…
But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand…
For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.
Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

translations.web: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
translations.bsb: By their fruit you will recognize them. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
translations.kjv: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
translations.asv: By their fruits ye shall know them. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
